title: Lens Grid Scans
subtitle: Scan rows that explain the next grid action
summary: PowerGrid Lens scans expose state, transfer, Index hints, MissionCore hints, and HoloMap marker ids.
body: Scan generators, Field Battery Banks, high-voltage trunks, and Factory Substations whenever a player is unsure what the grid is doing. Expanded rows point back to Index pages and the grid commissioning mission so the first Tech Wave does not depend on out-of-game notes.
